_comment: Which course folders get synced to a Google Doc, and in what order the pages appear.
To add a course: create an empty Google Doc, add its ID to the COURSE_DOC_IDS script
property in the Apps Script project, then add an entry here. Doc IDs deliberately do
'order' is optional — any page not listed is appended alphabetically, so adding a new
page never breaks the sync. 'skip' drops a page from the doc entirely.

cst499.intro: This is the full text of the CST499 course site, generated automatically from the course pages. It is here so you can give an AI assistant the whole course as context: paste this document in, or share the link, and then ask it questions about your own work. It is regenerated whenever the course site changes, so it is always current. Edits made in this document are overwritten on the next update — the course site is the source of truth.
